title: Free Press Action Launches 'Local News for the People,' a Collaborative Blueprint for Community-Centered Media | Free Press

facts.fact: The Media Power Collaborative, which created the agenda, is described by Free Press as a national network of more than 200 journalists, civic leaders, researchers, philanthropists and individuals.
facts.quote: a national network of more than 200 journalists, civic leaders, researchers, philanthropists and individuals who believe communities should be at the forefront of media-policy discussions

facts.fact: The agenda sets out five pillars to guide local-news policy interventions.
facts.quote: It lays out five pillars that should guide local-news policy interventions:

facts.fact: Ten community-media leaders authored the 'Local News for the People' agenda.
facts.quote: Ten community-media leaders authored this agenda, and it has been endorsed by more than 50 leading journalism, pro-democracy and civic-information organizations and outlets

facts.fact: According to the release, the agenda has been endorsed by more than 50 journalism, pro-democracy and civic-information organizations and outlets.
facts.quote: it has been endorsed by more than 50 leading journalism, pro-democracy and civic-information organizations and outlets, including LION Publishers
